notes.title: 🎂 The Anniversary Update is Here! 🎂
notes.notes:
[h3]Heya Tavern Dwellers, it's our birthday![/h3][p][/p][p]We're turning the big ol' [b]1[/b] guys! It's time to celebrate our birthday with a major update - a complete engine upgrade, a bunch of changes and balances and a ton of quality of life improvements.
[/p][h3]🎯 [b]What's New:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Complete Godot 4 engine upgrade[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Brand New Cards[/b] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Remastered music[/b] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Major balance overhaul[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Anniversary customization options[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality of life improvements[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012939/5834d76db52dcf16871d20f3cd6d1cc35c784836.png"][/img][/p][p]Here's a little sneak peek at some of the new cards![/p][p][/p][p][i]Read the full patch notes [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2400510/view/525350155171399617"]here[/url].[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Godot 4 upgrade[/b][/p][p]We’ve upgraded D&DG from using Godot version 3.6 to using version 4.4. We’ve done this for a few reasons:[/p][list][*][p]Make console ports easier[/p][/*][*][p]Get updates to the engine as they come out (Godot 3 is being updated much less than Godot 4) means the game is more future proofed[/p][/*][*][p]It’s just such a nicer engine to work in![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]👑 [b]Also Check Out: The Royal Writ![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333700/The_Royal_Writ/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Speaking of celebrations - our publisher [b]Yogscast Games[/b] just launched their new game [b]The Royal Writ[/b]![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]They have a [b]20% launch discount[/b] running for 2 weeks![/p][/*][*][p]We're bundled up with The Royal Writ so you can get an extra 10% off - complete the set![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012939/f47705c06dfcbe9d8f3c5a82ba1895106ac9629c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Anniversary Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p]It’s wild to think that it has already been a full year since [b]Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers[/b] first released! [/p][p][/p][p]In that time we’ve been working hard to make the game the very best it can be, and this update is another big improvement. It adds anniversary celebration cosmetics, a new Tarot deck, 10 new cards, a ton of improved animations, balance change, and changes to the game’s music. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone that continues to play and support the game, it means the world and it's why we can keep improving the game. We’re really excited to bring this update to you, so here are the update notes! [/p][p]- Mike[/p][p]

notes.title: Dungeons and Degenerate Gamblers update makes the new roguelike easier
notes.notes:
If you enjoyed Balatro, then there's a good chance you've already tried - or at least have eyes on - new Steam roguelike Dungeons and Degenerate Gamblers. The indie deckbuilder has been affectionately described as 'Blackjack Balatro' (although Balatro creator 'LocalThunk' is quick to remind people that DnDG was actually playable first, and that they highly endorse it). While it's a ton of fun and has received mostly positive reviews, the most common complaints at launch center on it feeling a little too tough, with some opponents feeling unfairly strong or having too much potential to scale out of control.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Shuffle Balatro into blackjack as this new roguelike game hits Steam
New deckbuilding roguelike is blackjack Balatro, and it has a demo

notes.title: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers Update now live for public beta testing
notes.notes:
Hello Tavern Dwellers! 

It's been just over a week since the Tavern opened, and it's been amazing to see you all enjoying your time with the game so far!

There has been lots of feedback coming through about every aspect of Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers, and this update addresses a big chunk of them. A big area of feedback has been to do with the balance, which has been significantly overhauled in this update.

[b]This updates aims to address:[/b]
[list]
[*] foe decks being too consistently strong compared to the player at the same stage in a run
[*] foes having the ability to scale out of control too easily, particularly when it comes to shields
[*] some events being too punishing / not rewarding enough
[*] it taking too long to start building synergies in your deck
[*] winning being too reliant on finding healing cards
[*] each run taking too much time
[*] bug fixes
[/list]
If you wish to join our public Beta to test the upcoming changes and provide feedback, you can do so by right clicking on the game in your Steam library, going to Properties, then Betas, then selecting "public_beta" from the dropdown menu.

If you have feedback or encounter any issues on the public beta, please do visit us on [url=https://discord.gg/6Ay3gkHThf]DISCORD[/url], as we would love to hear your feedback to help improve the game.

We hope you enjoy the changes!


Here are the changes that are currently being tested:
[b]Unique Chips[/b]
- increases number of Unique Chips to choose between to 3 (was 2)
- adds the choice to pay 100 chips to reroll Unique Chip choices
- changes starting chips to 250 (was 25)
- Double Down Chipotle Pepper damage reduced to 5 (was 6)
- Double Down Chip Damage damage threshold reduced to 3 (was 5)
- Double Down Chip Off the Old Block starting Advantage increased to -2 Advantage (was -3)

[b]Foil cards[/b]
- adds a 1.21% chance that cards rewarded after an encounter will be Foil
- the Foil cards rewarded after defeating Bouncer, Alucard, CEO, or Dracon are now guaranteed to be special cards, so no more disappointing Foil numbered cards

[b]Foe balancing[/b]
- foes now hit before player
  - this increases the strength of a number of cards that would often have no valid targets when drawn first
  - this also means the player is less often disrupted by cards like Business Card after they have already stood, especially early in a run when still reliant on standard playing cards
- adds the condition "you hit first" to ALL IN!
  - note that foe foil cards will still be played before the player hits
- increase most bosses to give 100 chips

[b]Tavern[/b]
Squire 
  - max HP to 21 (was 30)
Manager:
  - removes 1x Business Card from Manager's deck

[b]Lounge[/b]
Luck Pusher
  - swaps 0 The Fool and Terminate the Tower for 2x 8 of Nothings
  - removes Social Security Card
Teacher
  - changes lots of standard cards to Diamonds instead of Spades
  - removes Credit Card and Social Security Card
  - max HP to 40 (was 55)
Wizard
  - max HP to 35 (was 40)

[b]VIP Area[/b]
Mr President
  - removes Social Security Card

[b]Head Office[/b]
Psychologist
  - adds a 2x Zero of each suit to Psychologist's deck
  - changes 4x of Psychologist's 10s to 8s, and add a Blank Card
HR Department
  - removes Negative 3s
  - adds a set of 7s
  - removes 1x Queen of the Stone Age
Developer
  - adds 2x 5 of Nothing and 2x 9 of Nothing
Legal 
  - adds a 6, 7, 8 of Nothings
CEO
  - removes Expulsion
  - removes Calamari Game Cards
  - adds Diamond in the Rough

[b]Basement[/b]
Giant Rat
  - removes 4x Cue Card 
  - adds 2x 9 of Nothings
Decromancer
  - max HP to 52 (was 66)
Witch
  - max HP to 45 (was 52)

[b]Casino[/b]
- Dog is now the first encounter in the Casino (was Floorperson)
Floorperson
  - removes Jack and the Beanstalk from Floorperson's deck
Pit Boss
  - removes The Emperor IV, Carduus Acanthoides, and 5 of Wands from Pit Boss deck 

[b]Dungeon[/b]
Speedrunner
  - removes 1x Glitched Card
  - swaps all Clubs for Diamonds
Cultist
  - max HP to 52 (was 66)

[b]Despair[/b]
Deity of Despair
  - adds a Foil Rules Card
  - adds Business Card
  - swaps Ace of Spades for Ace of Nothings
  - swaps Ace of Clubs for Eleven of Clubs
  - these changes should allow for more counterplay chances against Deity of Despair's deck

[b]Gamblers[/b]
- adds more Scratchcards to Gambler decks in later floors

[b]Endless encounters[/b]
- adds a method to eventually end endless encounters
  - after 21 rounds have elapsed the Dealer will appear and add a Scratch to both player's discard piles every other round

Note
- some of the above changes to foe's decks only apply at Triple Down and below, so those looking for a challenge will still find it at Quadruple Down or ALL IN!

[b]Event balancing[/b]
- adds healing to Fortune Teller events, 10 HP per card flipped
- reduces Runaway Cart damage to 10
- reduces Surrounded damage to 8
- reduces Card Printer damage to 11
- changes VIP Area Trade Offer to offer any non-foil non-Tarot card, instead of 3 most recently added cards
- increases base healing of VIP Area Trade Offer to 8 (was 3)
- increase number of cards in Lost & Found shop to 8 (was 6)
- decreases Slot Machine shop buy (now 99) and spin costs (now 35) 

[b]Other balance changes[/b]
- Negative cards will not show up as encounter rewards in the Tavern to allow for a higher proportion of special cards to be offered
- swaps King of Gold in Signature Diamonds deck for a King of Diamonds
- changes XV The Devil to no longer damage self on a tied blackjack
- removes Queen of Music
  - Queen of Music will be back at some stage with a reworked effect, but right now this card is just causing the game to turn into tedious attrition battles whenever it shows up

[b]Changes to unlocking starting decks[/b]
- changes Signature decks to be unlocked by a win with that suit
- changes to show all 18 starting decks after first win with any deck

[b]Other improvements[/b]
- reduces the volume and intensity of the damage blocked by shield sfx
- when Glitched Card intensity is 0 the colours of the card will now still be glitched but with no movement so that you can still tell it is a Glitched Card
- changes Hope/Despair bosses to not show card reward when not on ALL IN
- changes X Wheel of Fortune to show the possible gifts as keyword tooltips
- changes Terminate the Tower to show the cards it can create
- slightly widen card hover tooltip sizes
- shorten names of 4 and 8 card shops so they fit on card better
- changes Fingerprint to the more clear "On play and on stand" instead of "On play and stand"
- Dungeon Counterfeiter now more clearly states that it gives a random Minor Arcana 5 
- move difficulty chips into place faster
- move cards onto/offscreen faster at start/end of encounter
- Slot Machine Shop animations scale to animation speed setting
- updates roles of some people in credits

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- fixes softlocks caused by Kingmaker and Radiation Detector changing the card that drew them halfway through its effect (i.e. Booster Pack or +2 Card)
- fixes a bug where the starting deck confirm button was still visible and clickable after backing out of selecting the current starting deck
- fixes a bug where the buttons on slot machine would be hidden instead of disabled after buying cards, and then never reshown
- fixes a bug where the price of a Chipcoin in Crypto Bro event wasn't being shown
- fixes a bug where the back button in Collection was not being disabled after being pressed
- fixes a bug where the game could crash when changing Collection pages using the hotkey while hovering a card
- fixes a bug where CEO card rewards weren't Foil cards
- fixes a bug where ID Cards on the Credits screen could be clicked multiple times in a row without having to unhover first
- fixes a bug where it was hard to get to the leftmost or rightmost played cards with KB/controller nav
- fixes Report Card having one random purple pixel on it
- fixes a bug where Rain Man would still discard even if it was locked
- fixes a bug where burning opponent's cards with some cards would not trigger Hot Chip:
  - Red Card
  - The Lovers VI
  - The Hermit IX

- fixes a bug where Insurance Card would only burn itself if it was the most recently drawn card (now can also burn the card under it)

- fixes Master of One and RJudgment not triggering Microchip

- fixes a bug where you could check what your face down cards were while Moon effect active by checking your deck in ID Card
- fixes bug where candles on Birthday Card would glitch when value beyond 21
- fix a crash in Stay a Night when trying to remove a random card when deck size is 0
- fix a crash in Have a Drink when trying to remove a card when deck size is 0

notes.title: v0.21 is here! The biggest update to D&DG EVER!
notes.notes:
I am beyond excited to share the latest update of Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers with you!

The 21st version of the demo had to be a special update, so me, the Yogscast artists (Jack, Nina-Serena, and Harry), and our composer (Element27) have been spending the necessary time in the tavern's kitchen cooking up the best and biggest update to the demo ever. So, without further ado, here is what is new:

[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] A complete art overhaul that preserves the pixel art aesthetic, but with a grimier, dank twist
[*] A brand new, dynamic soundtrack that changes with each game of blackjack
[*] A whole bunch of new cards, including a big set of Face cards
[*] Reworks of lots of existing cards, including some of the weaker Tarot cards
[*] A new card type: Foil cards
[*] New encounters
[*] A collection for tracking the cards you have added to your deck
[*] Customisable ID Card portrait
[*] Loads of bug fixes and QoL improvements
[*] Support for Simplified and Traditional Chinese
[/list]


[b]Art changes[/b]
[list]
[*] New backgrounds for every floor
[*] New UI and font for displaying card name, value, suit, and description
[*] Keyword highlighting and explanation
[*] New Hit and Stand buttons
[*] New ID Card and portraits for both player and opponents
[*] New art and animations for chips and Advantage
[*] New art for every Unique Chip
[*] New art and animations for gaining/losing health and shields
[*] New damage and grime on the cards themselves, which is randomised for each run
[*] Base resolution increased to 640x360 (was previously 480x270)
[/list]

[b]Music changes[/b]
[list]
[*] A whole new soundtrack, with a unique track for each floor
[*] A new track is added to the current track during each encounter, keeping the soundtrack fresh for every run
[/list]

[b]Keywords[/b]
[list]
[*] Several common effects have been changed to use keywords:
[*] On click -> Exploit
[*] +1 value if this doesn't cause a bust -> Rounds up
[*] Set your score to match your bust limit -> Instant blackjack
[*] Set your score to match opponent's score -> Instant draw
[*] Permanently remove card from your deck -> Shred
[*] View the next X cards in your draw pile -> Foresight X
[*] Adds to your hand -> Handy
[*] Discard without enacting 'on discard' effects -> Quick discard
[*] Worth 11 unless that busts, then worth 1 -> Flexible (11 or 1)
[/list]

[b]New cards[/b]
[list]
[*] Jackhammer of Clubs - Exploit: deal 5 damage, then burn.
[*] Jumping Jack - On hit or Exploit: move to opponents play pile.
[*] Jack and the Beanstalk - On stand: rounds up 4 times. On bust limit exceeded: take 5 damage and halve the value of this card.
[*] Monterey Jack - Exploit: heal 2 HP and burn. On stand: heals for 3 more HP this encounter.
[*] Jackpot - On stand: create 3 random Jacks, then put them in your draw pile. On discard: burn.
[*] Queen of Music - The next card you play this round becomes a Queen of Music for the rest of the encounter.
[*] Queen of Chess - Exploit: move to opponents play pile, then lock. At the start of next round: unlock.
[*] Queen of Wonderland - On play: choose another card currently in play and halve its value for the rest of this encounter.
[*] Killer Queen - On play: choose a card in your opponents play pile and burn it, then +2 value to this card.
[*] Queen of the Stone Age - Whenever you play a card worth 3 or 7: deal 3 damage.
[*] Dancing Queen - On hit or Exploit: changes card value in the order 10, 11, 10, 9, 10.
[*] Queen of Drag - On play: create a random Queen, add her to your hand, and set her value to 11.
[*] King of Gold - The next card played becomes a random Diamonds card for the rest of the encounter.
[*] King of the Hill - On play: instant blackjack if this is the only Face card currently in your deck.
[*] King of Kings - On play: burn all currently played Kings, then take 1 damage and gain 10 chips for each King burned.
[*] King Cobra - On play: take 3 damage, then deal 2 damage for every King currently in your deck.
[*] King of Space and Time - Handy. On play: move all your other played cards to your opponent's side, then stand. Can only be played if you have a Jack in play.
[*] Kingmaker - Handy. On play: choose another one of your played cards to turn into a random King.
[*] King of the World - On play: burn ALL other Face cards.
[*] Wild Card - Handy. On play: change the value of this card to match the top card in your discard pile.
[*] Ace in the Hole - Handy. Flexible (-1 or 1). Can only be played while exactly 1 above or below bust limit. On stand: if this card is in your hand, take 1 damage.
[*] Lucky Seven - On stand: if you have at least three cards with a value of 7 in play, gain 77 chips.
[*] Priceco Membership Card - On play: set value to 12, then create a 12 of a random suit then put it into your hand. Exploit: -3 value.
[*] Communist Party Card - On play: instant draw. On discard: discards to opponent's discard pile.
[*] Non-Fungible Card - On hit: set value to a random value between 1 and current value - 1.
[*] AI Generated Card - On play: randomly selects value and suit. Exploit: create a copy of this card, then move it to your opponent's play pile.
[*] Report Card - On play: gain 5 shield. If you have at least 11 shield, create an Ace of Spades, then put it into your hand. If you have at least 21 shield, make it a Foil.
[*] Rorschach Card - On stand: your opponent stands.
[*] Misprinted Card - On play: set value to 6, then create a Seven of Spades and put it in your hand. On stand: rounds up.
[*] Spade of Fives - On hit: if you already have a score of at least 16, gain 5 shield.
[*] Club of Fours - On hit: if you already have a score of at least 17, deal 4 damage.
[*] Diamond of Sixes - On hit: if you already have a score of at least 15, gain 6 chips.
[*] Heart of Threes - On hit: if you already have a score of at least 18, heal 3 HP.
[*] Plate of Escardgot - On stand: rounds up 2 times, then grant shield equal to card value. Exploit: lock. At the start of next round: unlock.
[*] Throwing Card - Flexible (11 or 1). On play: deal damage equal to your shield, then move this card to your opponent's play pile.
[*] Suit Yourself - Exploit: choose a card in your draw pile, then choose a suit to change it into for the rest of this encounter.
[*] Diamond in the Rough - On play: remove up to 10 shield from both players, then grant 2 chips per shield removed.
[*] Fingerprint Card - On play and stand: Exploit a random one of your played cards that has Exploit (does not cost Advantage).
[*] Master of One - On hit: create and play a One of a random suit.
[*] Zero of Spades
[*] Zero of Clubs
[*] Zero of Diamonds
[*] Zero of Clubs
[*] Negative One of Spades
[*] Negative One of Clubs
[*] Negative One of Diamonds
[*] Negative One of Clubs
[*] Ace of Nothings
[*] Jack of Nothings 
[*] Queen of Nothings
[*] King of Nothings
[/list]

[b]Card reworks[/b]
[list]
[*] Booster Pack - On play: create five random cards and put them in your hand. One will be a Foil. On discard: burn.
[*] Get Well Soon - On play: lock. On taking damage 3 more times: heal 10 HP and burn.
[*] Reverse Card - On play: swap who hits first.
[*] Time Card - Exploit while you have a card worth 9 or 5 in play: gain 10 chips.
[*] Kanban Card - On play: choose one card from the bottom 3 cards in your draw pile to move into your hand.
[*] XI Strength - Exploit while busted: hit button becomes re-enabled for one hit. Take 1 damage (increases by 1).
[*] XII The Hanged Man - On play: foresight 2, then choose one to quick discard.
[*] XIII Death - On play: choose a card from 1 of 3 currently in your deck to shred. On discard: burn.
[*] XIV Temperance - On play: gain 1 chip per card currently in your deck. On discard: burn.
[*] XVI The Tower - On play: lock your other played unlocked cards and unlock your other played locked cards.
[*] XVII The Star - On heal: deal damage equal to the amount healed.
[*] XX Judgment - On play: choose one of your burned cards to create a copy of, then move it to your draw pile.
[/list]

[b]Card changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Jack in the Box - now starts open (so is worth 10 by default)
[*] Glitched Card - now copies ALL kinds of effects, not just on play effects
[*] Glitched Card - is even more visually glitchy
[*] Glitched Card - can now copy from a wider range of cards
[*] +2 Card - now plays the on play effect of the played cards
[*] Baseball Card - created cards are now quick discarded instead of being put in play
[*] Hall Pass - increases foresight to 3
[*] II The High Priestess - increases foresight to 9
[*] VI The Lovers - cards created by this card now burn on discard
[*] VIII Justice - now transforms Jacks into Jackpots instead of Jack of all Trades
[*] VIII Justice - Jack transformation now lasts only for this encounter
[*] XVIII The Moon - can now be Exploited to remove the shroud for this round.
[*] 0 The Fool - no longer burns on discard
[*] Magic Trick Card - changes choices Queen of Diamonds and Seven of Spades instead of Queen of Hearts and Seven of Clubs
[*] Terminate the Tower - value changed from 0 to 4
[*] Break Limits - value changed from 0 to 1
[*] Sweep the Leg - value changed from 0 to 3
[*] Scratch - value changed from 0 to 2
[*] Old Baseball Card - now burns on discard
[*] Green Card - now moves the chosen card to the top of the opponent's draw pile
[*] Memory Card - now creates a copy of the remembered card on stand instead of on play
[/list]

[b]Foil cards[/b]
[list]
[*] Foil cards are a new card type added in this update
[*] Foil cards are added to your hand at the start of every encounter, and can be played from your hand without spending Advantage
[*] Foil cards are offered as a reward after defeating Alucard or Bouncer, and can also be created by some cards
[/list]

[b]New encounters and events[/b]
[list]
[*] Squire - a new Tavern encounter
[*] Thief - a new Lounge encounter
[*] Shop: Lost & Found - a new shop that gives a choice of cards that were previously skipped during this run
[/list]

[b]Balance changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Chip On Your Shoulder - can now only trigger once per round
[*] Alucard - has a Foil Blood Donor Card
[*] Alucard - has an additional Scratch
[*] Bouncer - has a Foil Twenty One of Spades
[*] Bouncer - one of his Ten of Nothings is now a Ten of Clubs
[*] Knight of Cardonia - has a stronger deck, but has moved to the Basement
[*] Fortune Teller - is now after the Manager encounter
[*] Teacher - now has a Report Card
[*] Luck Pusher - now has a 0 The Fool
[/list]

[b]Collection[/b]
[list]
[*] Adds a Collection book that tracks which cards you have added to your deck in a run
[/list]

[b]Customisable ID Card[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now customise your portrait using the ID Card on the title screen
[*] More customisations will be coming in the full release!
[/list]

[b]New settings and pause menu[/b]
[list]
[*] Adds a brand new settings screen, with a few new options
[*] Animation speed - defaults to 1
[*] Language (currently English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese are available, but more will be added) - defaults to Steam language, falls back to English
[*] Glitched Card visual effect intensity - defaults to 3
[*] Smoking allowed/no smoking - defaults to no smoking
[*] Settings screen is now accessible during a run from the pause menu
[*] The pause menu is now accessible at any point during a run (instead of just during encounters) by clicking the Escape key, or clicking the logo of the current floor
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Basic rules of the game are now displayed on the table of the tavern
[*] Several interactable elements (such as viewing your discard pile) have a red exclamation mark if you have never used them, to help new players discover them
[*] Adds a party animation to the Score Card when you have a blackjack
[*] Adds an error message and plays a failure sound effect when a card effect has no valid targets (e.g. Business Card played when opponent has no cards in play)
[*] Better controller and keyboard navigation on some interfaces
[*] If running in windowed mode, the window is now centred to the centre of the screen on start up
[*] The win and loss screens have both been reworked to make starting another run easier
[*] You can now view your deck on the loss screen
[*] Removes the lock icon from the mystery reward card
[/list]

[b]Other improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Adds the "of Nothings" starting deck
[*] Hovering cards is much snappier
[*] Unhovering cards is much bouncier
[*] Better deck/pile preview that allows for more cards to be displayed at once
[*] Deck/draw pile previews are now sorted by order in the Collection book, which improves grouping of similar cards
[*] Adds a fancy unfurling animation to the Fortune Teller event
[*] Optimisation on cards so that they can be loaded quicker, this greatly improves game performance when playing with decks with 100s of cards
[*] Lots of changes to card descriptions to reduce the length and complexity of the effect descriptions
[*] Lots of improvements to story text
[*] Makes the whole ID Card hoverable and clickable
[*] Adds new sound effect for Slot Machine shop
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] fixes a bug where Transit Card was adding to the end of the opponent's draw pile instead of a random position
[*] fixes a bug where the card hover 'tick' sound could play too often
[*] fixes a bug where cards that had a condition before they could be played from hand (i.e. Dark Mage) would use up 1 Advantage even if that condition meant that they weren't played
[*] fixes a bug where Glitched Card would remember values from previously copied cards, leading to strange behaviour when the new card needed to access those values
[*] fixes a bug where cards created by Four Mana Seven Seven were not triggering 'bust limit exceeded' effects
[*] fixes a bug where you could deal lower than expected damage with a low base damage but high damage multiplier

notes.title: Now live: version 0.11a of the demo!
notes.notes:
A quick update to improve balance and fix a few bugs.
This should reduce Alucard-related frustration, and brings Decromancer back in line now that Graveyards are suited as spades. It also gives more counterplay around Trap Card when the opponent has this card. 

- Valentines Card now burns
- Trap Card no longer locks
- Decromancer now has 66 health instead of 99
- adds a description of the gift granted to the description of X Wheel of Fortune after it is played
- makes X Wheel of Fortune visibly move a copy of itself into draw pile when that gift is rolled
- Official Trump Card sets its value back to 0 before you make a choice to make it clear what its effect will be - this was affecting subsequent draws of this card in the same encounter
- fixes a bug where all the card sound effect audio was coming out of the left channel
- fixes a bug where Glitched Card wouldn’t update it’s newly picked value before card effect enacted - was meaning the 5 value didn’t get added before Booster Pack choice when Glitched Card rolled Booster Pack
- fixes a bug where Glitched Card would block hitting or standing if it rolled Gravecard and then Gravecard was clicked

notes.title: Now live: version 0.11 of the demo!
notes.notes:
I’m back from holiday and back working on the game! Here are the change notes for the latest demo release, v0.11, which is now live on Steam!
This release adds a new encounter, a new event, and changes the way the game is laid out for better readability and use of screen space. There are also a number of balance changes and bug fixes. 
Look out for more coming next week!

[b]New stuff:[/b]
- adds a new event to the Basement - it’s a card removal shop!
- new encounter added to the Basement - it’s a familiar face, but with an improved deck since the last time you saw them!
- when Glitched Card is the mystery reward card the whole card back will now have the glitched effect instead of just the corners

[b]Layout changes:[/b]
- layout changes so that cards in play are more visible and more cards can be in play at once and still be visible
- changes to spacing of cards in hand so that they don’t overlap the discard piles
- changes the discard pile to a pile that must be clicked on to see the cards in it (like the draw pile)
- lowers the draw and discard pile positions so that text on choices can always be read

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
- makes Slime stronger by adding a Get Well Soon Card and a Get Out of Jail Free Card
- makes Alucard stronger by removing some cards that made him bust too often
- changes Sweep the Leg effect to “Set opponent bust limit to 20 and your bust limit to 22 for the rest of this encounter. Burns”
- changes the value of Booster Pack to 5
- Four Mana Seven Seven no longer locks
- VI The Lovers now has hearts as its suit
- changes the value of XVII The Star to 17
- Gravecard now has spades as its suit

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- add a “final stamp” to the Loyalty Card when it triggers
- changes Magic Trick Card to set its value to 0 on play (before choice made) so that it is more clear what your choice will do on subsequent plays
- fixes a bug where the first potion from loot boxes could be clicked quickly and it wouldn’t have any effect
- fixes a bug where the Loyalty Card couldn’t have its value increased by The Victim Card
- fixes various typos

notes.title: Now live: version 0.10b of the demo!
notes.notes:

This release adds 3 more music tracks which are randomly selected from at the start of each floor. This isn't the final music, and this isn't the way music will work in the game forever, but it gives everyone’s ears a break from the same 49s loop of music that has been in the game since day 1 😂

[list]

[*] Fixes a bug where you could skip encounters after the Shop and the Trade Offer
[/list]

notes.title: Now live: version 0.8 of the demo!
notes.notes:
At long last, version 0.8 of the demo has just been released! 

This version completely overhauls the way that card effects work under the hood. They are now much more consistent and less buggy, especially when card effects interact with each other, and it’s going to be significantly easier for me to add new card effects in the future!

Improvements:
- The game is much faster overall, with the card movements animations in particular being shortened

Loot Box event fixes
- fixes a bug where you could quickly open a new loot box after clicking last potion which would mean that the next loot box only showed one potion and all rewards couldn't be collected
- makes the skip rewards button skip card and heal potions
- makes the loot box opening animation get faster as you open more boxes
- fixes a bug where more than one "open loot box" card could be dealt if you clicked rewards and skip button quickly

Notable bug fixes and changes:
- Dark Mage can now be played by the opponent
- XI Strength now cannot skip the next opponent round if the opponent had already stood
- changes IV The Emperor, V The Hierophant, XV The Devil, XVII The Star, and XVIII The Moon to be checked when round ends
    - this also fixes a bug where if they were swapped to other player their effect stayed on the first player
- changes XVIII The Moon shroud to be checked whenever moving cards
- Glitched Card now works more consistently
- fixes a bug where Valentines Card wasn't suited as hearts
- fixes a bug where loyalty stamps weren't being correctly removed after filling the Loyalty Card
- fixes a bug with the Joker where it wouldn't set it's value to 0 if there were no cards in discard pile
- fixes a bug where beer and a shot wasn't costing 100 chips
- fixes a bug where the Trade Offer event could offer the same card that The Collector requested
- fixes a bug where you could choose the Beer and a Shot option while having less than 10 health
- fixes a bug where killing the opponent using Scratch or Wheel of Fortune would allow them to play one more card before the encounter ending
- swaps the Poker Players Jack of Clubs for Jack of Diamonds
- several tweaks to card descriptions

I’m really excited to be done with this overhaul as now I can get back to adding new features, cards, and encounters!

notes.title: Version 0.7 of the demo has just been released!
notes.notes:
This release reworks the Spades blackjack effect, adds a new event, a new encounter, and tweaks the balance of a few cards. And of course, there are a few bug fixes included too!

[b]New stuff![/b]
- Loot Box event!
Is your life missing a sense of pride and accomplishment? Then you’ve come to the right place! Click the button, see the flashy effects, be disappointed by the meagre reward, and then do it all again! At least until you run out of money…
- New Basement opponent: Slime 

[b]Balance changes![/b]
- On a winning blackjack, Spades now grant a shield that lasts for the encounter
- Terminate the Tower now immediately plays the card instead of it going into your hand as it was too strong and flexible before
- Key Card now locks when played (so that it can optionally unlock itself if there is no good unlock target)
- Official Trump Card now costs 5x the number of selected pips to play

[b]Bug fixes![/b]
- Joker value now gets reset to 0 before making a choice so that the score card is accurate to score before the new value of the joker is added
- Fixes a bug where if opponent played Dark Mage with nothing to burn it wouldn't get moved to play pile correctly
- Fixes a bug where the Official Trump Card wasn’t suited as diamonds 
- Clarifies the winning blackjack effect of negative cards
- Adjusts the description of the Card Sleeve to make it clear it affects cards you have in play not all cards in play
- Adjusts Sweep the Leg description to make it clear it lasts for the encounter

notes.title: Now live: version 0.6 of the demo!
notes.notes:
[u]Version 0.6 is now available on Steam! [/u]
This version adds four new cards, a new event, a new encounter, and a few important bug fixes!

[b]New cards![/b]
- Card Sleeve
Choose a card that is currently in play and lock that card, then burn this card
- Baseball Card
Each time this card is discarded permanently reduce its value by 1. When this card's value is reduced to 0, burn it, permanently remove it from your deck, put a Card Sleeve and an Old Baseball Card in play and permanently add those to your deck
- Old Baseball Card
It has no effect
- The Victim Card
Adds to your hand. If you take damage while this is in play add 1 to the value of every card in your opponent’s play pile

[b]New event![/b]
- Adds the Trade Offer Event
The Collector has his eye on three of your cards, and will offer cards from his deck to trade for them.

[b]New encounter![/b]
- The Collector
Be aware that cards you have traded to The Collector and his cards that you declined to trade for in the Trade Offer will be added to The Collector’s deck when you battle him. Think carefully whether you want to allow him to have that card… 

[b]Improvements and bug fixes![/b]
- The Kanban Card now burns itself after being drawn 5 times to prevent softlocks due to having multiple Kanban Cards
- Fixes a bug where I The Magician wasn’t burning
- Fixes a bug where shrouded cards weren’t covering parts of the card added after playing (i.e., Gravecard hand, Loyalty Card stamp)
- Fixes a gamebreaking bug where 4 Mana 7/7 art had one pixel in the wrong place!

I’m very excited about this release! I had started on the Trade Offer Event and The Collector encounter last week but they weren’t quite ready for release then. Looking forward to seeing how you like the event and encounter interacting with each other, and how that changes the way you approach the trades. Let me know if you want to see more complex events like this in the future!

notes.title: Now live: Version 0.5 of the demo!
notes.notes:
[u]Version 0.5 of the demo has just been released![/u]
This release is mostly focused on some of the most highly requested changes and improvements.

[b]New stuff![/b]
[list]
[*] Adds a highlight effect when score is equal to max score to show that blackjack effect is active
[*] Cards are now shuffled back into draw pile much faster
[/list]

[b]Balance changes![/b]
[list]
[*] Changes opponent AI to respect changed bust limit rather than standing at 17 or higher
[*] Opponents will now stand at 4 below their current bust limit
[*] Fixes Aces so that they can increase back to 11 as long as that wouldn’t cause a bust
[*] Locked cards cannot be discarded anymore
[*] Changes Cue Card so that it cannot send itself to the bottom of the draw pile
[*] Changes Bartender health from 10 → 5
[*] Changes Decromancer health from 130 -> 99
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes![/b]
[list]
[*] Fixes a bug where the game would crash after opponent played a card that plays into the hand
[*] Fixes a bug where if the Cue Card was the last card in draw pile, after sending a card to the bottom the draw pile would appear empty
[*] Fixes a bug where the player could still hit or stand briefly after losing
[/list]

Please keep the feedback and bug reports coming! 
No new Basement stuff in this release, but I've started the work for it so it will definitely be in next week's version!

notes.title: Now live: demo version v0.4
notes.notes:
Version 0.4 of the demo is now out!

New stuff!
[list]
[*] Adds the beginning of the Basement to the demo
[*] New Basement opponents: Giant Rat, and Decromancer
[*] New card:
[/list]
Cue Card: Choose a card from your play or discard pile to put at the bottom of your draw pile

Bug fixes!
[list]
[*] fixes a bug that meant the loss screen 'main menu' button wasn't working
[*] fixes a bug where the game would crash if hovering cards while they were being moved to the draw pile
[*] fixes a bug where if you hit with an empty draw pile and empty discard pile you'd be unable to hit or stand
[*] fixes a bug where a Trap Card on both sides could crash the game
[*] fixes a bug where cards in hand would be off centred when hand size was very large
[*] modifies Dark Flower so that it doesn't lock if there are no cards in draw pile
[*] fixes a bug where previewing the discard pile would trigger start of turn card effects
[*] fixes a bug that mean that while XVIII The Moon was shrouding the opponent's play pile you could hover the score card to see their current score
[/list]

Thank you all so much for the continued support, this game is getting better and better because of the suggestions and feedback that you are all giving.
Please let me know how you like the new enemies and the Cue Card! 
There will be more Basement coming soon!

notes.title: Now live: Version 0.2 of the demo
notes.notes:
The newest version of the demo is now live! This version is primarily focused on fixing bugs that were discovered since the demo went live.

Here's a list of the changes in version 0.2 of the demo:

[b]New features and improvements:[/b]
- adds a new card mat background for the Basement
- fixes multiple places where quickly selecting a choice could skip encounters, add multiple reward cards to your deck, enact events multiple times, inadvertently make a choice while clearing dialogue, or just straight up crash the game!
- overhauls the Wheel of Fortune card
- speeds up the end of encounter 'collect cards' animation
- fixes The Moon not correctly shrouding opponent cards

[b]Clarity improvements:[/b]
- improves the effect description of the Scratch Card
- fixes the effect descriptions for One of Spades, Clubs, Diamonds, and Hearts to match other suited "regular" cards
- fixes the help text not showing when choosing a card from The World 
- fixes the help text being out of date for The High Priestess
- fixes the name of the game when running in Windows to have an '&' not an 'and'

I hope you enjoy this new, more stable version of the demo, and thanks again to everyone who helped to find these bugs, especially the members of the Discord!
